Package org.applecommander.archive.zip

package org.applecommander.archive.zip

ZIP archive format support.

ZIP is a widely-used archive and compression format identified by the signature 0x504B0304 ("PK\\x03\\x04") at the beginning of the file. It supports multiple compression methods, per-entry CRC-32 integrity checksums, and file metadata including creation, last access, and last modification timestamps.

This package provides a FileStore implementation that reads and writes standard ZIP archives using Java's built-in ZipInputStream and ZipOutputStream. It exposes archived files through the standard AppleCommander file store API with support for browsing, extracting, creating, and deleting entries. Each entry preserves its compression method, compressed and uncompressed sizes, compression ratio, CRC-32 checksum, and file timestamps.

Unlike Apple II-specific archive formats, ZIP does not natively store ProDOS metadata such as file type, auxiliary type, or access mode. Files are stored with their data fork content and standard ZIP metadata (name, timestamps, compression attributes).
